title: Natural polynomial fibre comparison with the presentation ideal
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $S$ an $R$-algebra, $q\in\operatorname{Spec}S$, $n\in\mathbb N$, and $\varphi:P=R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]\twoheadrightarrow S$ a surjective $R$-algebra map [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Put $p=q\cap R$, $k=\kappa(p)$, $I=\ker\varphi$, $Q=\varphi^{-1}(q)$, $A=P_Q$, and $m=pA$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let $\rho:P\to k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ be the coefficient map and $\bar I$ the ideal generated by $\rho(I)$. Suppose the prime of $k\otimes_R S$ corresponding to $q$ admits a principal neighbourhood which is a global complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. There is a prime $t\in\operatorname{Spec}(k[x]/\bar I)$ with such a principal complete-intersection neighbourhood and a ring isomorphism $e:A/m\simeq k[x]_{\widetilde t}$, where $\widetilde t$ is the inverse image of $t$ under the quotient map. Under the composite $A\to A/m\xrightarrow{e}k[x]_{\widetilde t}$, the ideal $IA$ maps to $\bar I k[x]_{\widetilde t}$. No count of ideal generators is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the fibre quotient equivalence k tensor_R S = k[x]/Ibar by the universal properties of tensor products and polynomial algebras. The forward map is the tensor lift of the scalar map and the map S to k[x]/Ibar descended along the surjective φ. The inverse sends each polynomial variable to 1 tensor φ(X_i), and kills Ibar because the composite on P is 1 tensor φ. The inverse identities follow by checking variables and pure tensors, using surjectivity of φ. The equivalence sends a tensor φ(b) to the class of C(a)ρ(b). Thus it requires no flatness.

Contract the fibre prime corresponding to q along the inverse fibre quotient equivalence to get t. A fibre CI chart element h maps to a chart element in k[x]/Ibar outside t. Localization of the algebra equivalence at the powers of the corresponding elements identifies the two chart rings. The definition of global complete intersection is invariant under algebra equivalence: transport the polynomial quotient presentation and use the homeomorphism of spectra to preserve Krull dimension.

Use polynomial scalar extension E:k tensor_R P = k[x]. Pull the inverse-image prime of t back through E to U in the polynomial fibre. Its contraction to P is Q: for b in P, the fibre quotient formula sends 1 tensor φ(b) to [ρ(b)], and the fibre prime contracts to q. E also sends 1 tensor b to ρ(b).

The natural fibre local-ring quotient equivalence at U identifies A/(pP)A with the localization of k tensor_R P at U. The scalar-tower formula identifies (pP)A with pA=m. Localize E to the inverse-image prime of t and compose. This gives e:A/m to k[x] localized there, sending the class of b/1 to ρ(b)/1. Mapping I along this formula gives the equality of ideals: both sides are the ideal generated by these images, and ideal maps preserve spans and composition.

theorem exists_syntomic_polynomial_fibre_comparison
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) (n : ℕ) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R →ₐ[R] S)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hci : ∃ h : (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).Fiber S,
      h ∉ (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S))
        ⟨q, rfl⟩).asIdeal ∧
      IsGlobalCompleteIntersection (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).ResidueField
        (Localization.Away h)) :
    let p := q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)
    let k := p.ResidueField
    let P := MvPolynomial (Fin n) R
    let A := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ.toRingHom)
    let m := p.map (algebraMap R A)
    let Ibar := (RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R k))
    ∃ t : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ Ibar),
      (∃ h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ Ibar,
        h ∉ t.asIdeal ∧ IsGlobalCompleteIntersection k (Localization.Away h)) ∧
      ∃ e : (A ⧸ m) ≃+*
          Localization.AtPrime (t.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ibar)),
        ((RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom).map (algebraMap P A)).map
            (e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk m)) =
          Ibar.map (algebraMap _
            (Localization.AtPrime (t.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ibar))))
